I can't run the experiments or see results, so this is design only. The 100 experiments below form 20 blocks of 5. Within each block the edit is fixed and one parent edge cycles through all five ops, so each block isolates one condition on one edit. The blocks cover edits on every edge and parent edges both on the path and off the path, and they include the case where the parent edge is the edited edge.
